overzichtModel.query: FROM (SELECT f.* FROM dienst_reservering AS f :f.where) AS f JOIN dienst_contracten AS cc ON f.dienst_contract_id = cc.dienst_contract_id JOIN klanten AS k ON f.klant_id = k.klant_id JOIN dienst_reservering_regels AS r ON f.dienst_reservering_id = r.dienst_reservering_id JOIN dieren AS dier ON r.dier_id = dier.dier_id JOIN rassen AS ras ON dier.ras_id = ras.ras_id JOIN diersoort AS soort ON ras.diersoort_id = soort.diersoort_id LEFT JOIN voertuig AS v ON cc.voertuig_id = v.voertuig_id

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(d.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM dienst_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.dienst_reservering_id = f.dienst_reservering_id))
veld.label: Dier(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(soort.naam ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM dienst_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id LEFT JOIN diersoort AS soort ON ras.diersoort_id = soort.diersoort_id WHERE (r.dienst_reservering_id = f.dienst_reservering_id))
veld.label: Diersoort(en)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(concat(ras.naam,IF(d.kruising,' (kr.)','')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM dienst_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id LEFT JOIN rassen AS ras ON d.ras_id = ras.ras_id WHERE (r.dienst_reservering_id = f.dienst_reservering_id))
veld.label: Ras(sen)

veld.naam: (SELECT group_concat(IF(d.geslacht = 'Mannelijk','M',IF(d.geslacht = 'Vrouwelijk','V','?')) ORDER BY d.naam ASC separator '; ') AS dieren FROM dienst_reservering_regels AS r JOIN dieren AS d ON r.dier_id = d.dier_id WHERE (r.dienst_reservering_id = f.dienst_reservering_id))
veld.label: Geslacht
